purpose: Known pre-existing absorption findings, recorded so scripts/validators/validate_agent_run_absorption_completeness.js can hard-fail on anything NEW without pretending these are fixed.
policy: SHRINK_ONLY. An entry that stops reproducing must be deleted from this file; the validator fails if a listed finding no longer occurs. Nothing may be added here to make a new failure go away.
why_empty: All three findings were closed rather than waived, and the mechanism is kept so the next pre-existing finding is recorded here instead of being waived. The three were: (1) 2026-07-31/uscis-medical named a route with a missing slash - community-questionswhat-is-... - which the resolver has always canonicalized correctly; the validator was comparing the RAW named target against the RESOLVED ledger path, so a perfectly absorbed page read as a silent drop. The join now goes through scripts/lib/citation_route_resolver.js, the same function the intake used. (2) 2026-08-05/trt named insights/trt-002.html, resolved by the numbered-stem rule to insights/trt-002-how-to-compare-trt-clinics-in-2026.html and ledgered there; same join defect, same fix. (3) 2026-08-05/trt named insights/trt-003-trt-injections-vs-gel-how-to-decide.html, and this one was a REAL mis-resolution: resolveTargetPath matched on the serial alone and pointed the repair at insights/trt-003-how-to-compare-local-options-using-a-real-decision-checklist.html, a page about a different subject. The resolver now prefers the descriptive slug over the serial (resolveDescriptiveNumberedSlug), the ledger was re-resolved onto insights/trt-022-trt-injections-vs-gel-how-to-decide.html, and the URL the agent actually tested now 301s there - it was 404ing because the alias lane rejected every .html route on its dot.
